messages:
Maria L: Heads up — seeing a sharp drop in traces for prefetcher-prod starting ~03:10 UTC. Only root spans are showing, child spans mostly missing. Sampling UI shows 1% but traffic would justify ~20%. Any quick places to check?

Jon P: Which service/cluster exactly? prefetcher-prod in k8s? Can you paste an example trace id or a panel link?

Maria L: Yep prefetcher-prod (k8s). Example trace: https://traces.redwood.internal/trace/abcd1234 — grafana panel for the service: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/prefetcher/traces?orgId=1

Raj S: We pushed a sampler change in the infra migration yesterday. First quick checks: 1) OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER env on the deployment, 2) SDK versions across services (mismatch can cause parent-based fallthrough), 3) any exporter errors in logs.

Maria L: grabbing the deployment env: ```kubectl -n prod get deploy prefetcher -o yaml | yq '.spec.template.spec.containers[0].env[] | select(.name=="OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER" or .name=="OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG")'```
Output: 
- name: OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER
  value: "parentbased_traceidratio"
- name: OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG
  value: "0.01"

Kevin B: That 0.01 matches the UI. Parent-based with a low ratio can drop child spans if parent context not propagated — especially with async workers. Which runtime? Node? Python?

Maria L: Node 18 (worker), python ingestion downstream. Prefetcher uses async worker threads + a small microbatcher.

Olivia K: I suspect the parent context isn't being propagated through the batcher. Quick test: bump OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG to 0.05 in a canary and enable OTEL_LOG_LEVEL=DEBUG for the exporter to see sampling decisions. I'll canary zone-a.

Jon P: Also check SDK versions: run `kubectl -n prod exec -it <pod> -- node -p "require('package.json').dependencies['@opentelemetry/sdk-trace-node'] || 'unknown'"` or check pip freeze for python. We've seen mismatch 1.18 vs 1.22 cause parent-based oddness.

Olivia K: Kicking off canary now — updating deployment in zone-a only. Command I used: ```kubectl -n prod set env deploy/prefetcher OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG=0.05 OTEL_LOG_LEVEL=DEBUG --selector=zone=zone-a```

deploy-bot: Started rollout: prefetcher prod canary (zone-a) — sampling=0.05, debug logging enabled. Rollout id: r-20260316-0418. Link: https://deploys.redwood.internal/r/r-20260316-0418

Olivia K: Canary is up at 04:18 UTC. Watching traces now.

Maria L: Canary trace looks good — child spans returned for trace abcd1234-canary: https://traces.redwood.internal/trace/abcd1234-canary. Looks like propagation bug + aggressive sampling.

Kevin B: I'll open a tracking issue to upgrade OTEL SDKs and add a test for parent propagation in the microbatcher path. Filed ENG-PLAT-2345 with repro steps and a suggested fix (instrument async_hooks / context manager).

Raj S: Can we keep default sampler at 5% until we have an SDK upgrade rollout? Also we should adjust the alert: currently the alert fires on absolute trace count drop — update to include sample-rate metric (observability.alerts#prefetcher_sample_rate) so we don't panic when sampling intended to be low.

Maria L: Agreed, 5% seems fine as a safety buffer. Olivia, can you roll the 0.05 to all zones once Kevin confirms?

Olivia K: Rolling to all zones at 04:32 UTC. Commands used: ```kubectl -n prod set env deploy/prefetcher OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG=0.05 OTEL_LOG_LEVEL=INFO``` Then `kubectl rollout status deploy/prefetcher` — all zones green.

Maria L: Child spans restored across samples. Thanks.

Kevin B: Added dashboard/update PR: https://git.redwood.internal/eng-platform/pull/789 — includes sample-rate panel and an alert change to require sample_rate < 0.02 AND traces_per_min < threshold. Also added runbook steps for quick bump and canary.

Raj S: For logs — exporter errors show up in Kibana index `prefetcher-otlp-*`. Kibana quick link: https://kibana.redwood.internal/app/discover#/prefetcher-otlp-*/_search?q=level:ERROR%20AND%20message:exporter

Maria L: Perfect. Kevin, Raj — can you add the runbook to the ops wiki and tag eng-oncall? I want the steps visible for next time.

Kevin B: Will do. Added to runbook and scheduled a follow-up to upgrade OTEL SDKs in the next sprint.

Olivia K: TL;DR: root cause likely parent-context drop + too-low sampling. Temporary mitigation: sampler -> 5% + debug logs while we patch SDK/context propagation.

Maria L: Awesome — thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Jon P: Nice quick ops. Closing the loop once ENG-PLAT-2345 is resolved.
